# EvRadioGroup

> Holds a set of radios under one name and one v-model, so exactly one of them is chosen.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:radio-group` |
| Layer | Molecule (`src/molecules`) |
| Import | `import { EvRadioGroup } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvRadioGroup>` or `<ev-radio-group>` |
| Source | `src/molecules/radio-group/EvRadioGroup.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<div class="ev-radio-group">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvRadioGroup model-value="transfer">
  <EvRadio value="transfer" label="Transfer bank" />
  <EvRadio value="va" label="Virtual account" />
  <EvRadio value="tunai" label="Tunai" disabled />
</EvRadioGroup>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

Its default slot is built to hold `EvRadio` (`evoq-ui:radio`).

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Radio Group**, frame `4015:62616` (Radio Button). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use to pick exactly one option from a short, mutually exclusive set.
- Use when all options should be visible at once (2–6 items).
- Use a subtext to clarify an option without leaving the list.
- Use a default selection when a safe or common choice exists.

### When not to use

- Don't use to select multiple options  →  use Checkbox (`evoq-ui:checkbox`)
- Don't use for on/off of one setting  →  use Toggle (`evoq-ui:toggle`)
- Don't use for long option lists  →  use Select
- Don't leave a group with nothing selectable.

### Do

- Keep options in one group with a single name
- Order options logically or by frequency
- Keep labels parallel and concise
- Make both the radio and its label clickable

### Don't

- Leave nothing selected when a default is expected
- Mix radios from different groups in one list
- Use a radio to trigger an action — it sets state
- Nest a radio group inside another option

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvRadioGroup`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<div class="ev-radio-group">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:radio-group` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
